name: xml_set_namespace
title: Points a node at a namespace that an ancestor already declared

origin.description: Points a node at a namespace that an ancestor already declared.
origin.example: x <- read_xml("<root xmlns:f=\"http://foo.com\"><a/></root>"); xml_set_namespace(xml_child(x), prefix = "f"); paste(capture.output(x), collapse = "\n")

translation.description: Points a node at a namespace that an ancestor already declared.
translation.example: x = read_xml('<root xmlns:f="http://foo.com"><a/></root>'); xml_set_namespace(xml_child(x), prefix="f"); str(x)
